pages.text: Firewood piled outside the shed. Grandpa stacked it like a wall. Fuel for the whole winter.
Nils wanted to build one side himself. "I'll stack this side my way!" He rolled up his sleeves.
Grandpa laid logs down side by side. Nils stood one upright and glanced at him.
One upright log, two, three. A pointy tower.
Grandpa's wall grew wider. Nils's tower grew taller and crooked.
The tower tipped and wobbled. Nils quickly stepped back.
Crash! Every log fell. His spot was empty again. Grandpa's wall was already shoulder-high.
Grandpa laid two logs side by side, then two more crosswise on top. He pressed them with his palm to show Nils.
Nils laid logs down too. One, another, side by side. A firm push, and they stayed steady.
One side of the wall was full! "This is the wall I stacked." Grandpa leaned his back against it and chuckled.
